The best mobile game I've ever played is Pixel Dungeon. It's a old-school roguelike game with randomized rooms, items, potions, everything. It's also free and doesn't have any ads, which is the biggest plus out of all of them.

There's also a few different mods of it, Shattered Pixel Dungeon adds a bunch of different items and fleshes out certain enemies and mechanics. There's a few others that add other things as well.

It's pretty difficult though, and you'll die a lot to begin with. But keep at it and it's a lot of fun!
